item.title: Musk's data centers push out family that's owned land for generations
item.description: A plant in Southaven, Mississippi, that powers Elon Musk's SpaceXAI data centers in the area has sparked backlash from residents concerned about noise and air pollution.

item.title: Mayor to homeowner losing sleep over data center plant: "Consider selling"
item.description: Noise from a Mississippi plant powering Elon Musk's xAI data centers in the area is causing migraines, ringing ears and sleepless nights, residents say.

item.title: Detecting deepfakes, in a world where even reality is suspect
item.description: Hany Farid, a leading expert on deepfakes and digital manipulation, estimates that half of the content widely viewed on the Internet is fake. What does this mean for our ability to detect images generated or hallucinated by artificial intelligence?
